notes: Torah #227 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=227. The Torah itself describes a causal mechanism — the wicked reincarnated in rooftop grasses lack elevation because no one reaps them and no blessing is said over them, while harvested grain receives blessing and thereby rises — but these causal relationships were not encoded as eitza edges in the dataset. The two existing packages (Package 1: evil cluster of wicked/rooftop grasses; Package 2: good cluster of harvested grain/blessing/elevation) were built from bechina analysis of the source text. The implicit causal flow between Package 2 (harvesting + blessing -> elevation) and the absence of that flow for Package 1 (no harvesting -> no elevation) would be the natural eitza structure, but with zero edges there are no nodes to assign.
